As the marble approaches the bottom, the slope widens and flattens out into a shallow, collecting basin, where the rolling movement slows before the marble settles in place.

The marble starts at the top and accelerates as it moves downward, bouncing realistically off the curved walls of the funnel. The viewer sees a clean, minimalist visualization with a red marble rolling along the internal surfaces of a white container, demonstrating basic physics in a visually engaging way.
